fusions.name: Recited Weave
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to recite, then casts a cone of woven arcana out to 6 tiles, which deals 26 damage to everything caught in it, ignores their resistances and has a 50% chance to leave each [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unpicked Ward
fusions.desc: A precise strike deals 12 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Practised Weaving
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Well-Rehearsed Pattern
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You have 8% arcane resistance.
